name: FMCats Wisconsin 2023

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors

information:
**There is no 3x3 at this competition.** If you are looking for a competition with more standard events, please check out [Swallow Spring 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwallowSpring2023).

This competition will have three cats roaming around the venue. 

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Assocation](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
